finding.text: `ux/Dictate/doc/upload.md` is new but not listed in `ux/Dictate/doc/files.jsonl` (no "upload" line there); the readme links it, but the doc index does not (law 10).

The task folder has no outcome: `session.jsonl` ends at a commit line with no landed/summary, and requirements.md asks for "each hop's time before and after, and the cause, in 4 lines" to vscode-mastermind. upload.md's table covers the round trip and upload cost, but not the `Sessions.say` write or the view draw hop for V1/V2/V3, and its link "per-run fit in the task log" points at a bare folder. A fresh agent cannot tell what was reported or what V2/V3 timings were.

The mu-law change in `ux/Dictate/capture.js` `wav()` also reaches `ux/Dictate/variants/v1/Dictate.js:340`, but V1 does not get the "drop the guess in flight" fix (only `Dictate.js` does), and nothing in upload.md or the readme says V1 changed bytes; also `audio/MicStream/readme.md:10` and `audio/MicStream/page.js:45` say they "copy" capture.js and still say 16-bit, so the two copies now differ undocumented.

`ext/Chat/v3/ChatV3.css:17-18` comment still says the draft text is "gray", but `.chat-v3-text.is-moving` is now solid `--final-ink` (line 20), so `transition: color .4s` on line 19 does nothing. Requirement 2 ("dim until finalized") is met only via `.chat-v3-guess`; fix the comment and decide whether `is-moving` should stay.
`ux/Dictate/capture.js:164` JSDoc is updated, but `ux/Dictate/doc/silence.md:73` still asserts every posted WAV is "16-bit RIFF"; now false by default.

`--draft-ink`/`--final-ink` (framework.css) are documented only in the Dictate readme; the colour rules (`/framework/design/color/`) don't list the pair, and `.chat-v2-raw-line` lost its `--subtle` dimming and italic-only cue, so V2 raw lines are now full ink. Shots `shots/ink-1200.png` and `shots/ink-400.png` exist but no contrast number for `--draft-ink` (70% mix) on dark bubbles is recorded.
Simpler alternative: `--final-ink: currentColor` is a no-op token (same as not setting `color`); only `--draft-ink` needs to exist, though a named pair reads clearly.
